name: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd
title: Muthoot Capital Services Ltd - 511766 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 PAT hit by ~INR76 crore FY impairment and a INR15.5 crore corporate NPA; reported GNPA 6.96% with accrual, co-lending run-off and cost of funds down INR0.60 are the main positives, but no supply or pricing discipline evidence.

triggers.label: FY26 impairment INR76 crore
triggers.quote: For the whole year, I have booked INR76 crores of impairment expense, right, sir, whereas last financial year, it was only INR18 crores

triggers.label: Disbursement growth absent per analyst
triggers.quote: our disbursement has also not grown enough

triggers.label: Dividend and profit target deferred
triggers.quote: Now I will not say like that, by the end of this financial year, you will be having this and that.

triggers.label: Cost of funds 10.09% → 9.48% QoQ
triggers.quote: at Q4, I was at 10.09% whereas in -- sorry in Q3, whereas in Q4, we closed our total cost of fund at 9.48%

triggers.label: Co-lending book 940 → 595 crore
triggers.quote: the co-lending portfolio, which was INR940 crores at the start of the year, we closed at INR595 crores

guidance.quote: We are targeting close to INR3,000 crores of disbursement
We are looking at INR10,000 crores by '28, '29, somewhere thereabout.
we'll be somewhere around 70%, 75% as a whole
Pretax ROA we have computed as a whole for MCSL would be around 2.5% to 2%.

guidance.value: around INR400 crores (INR200 crores upfront, INR200 crores milestone-linked CCPS)
guidance.quote: we wanted to target INR400 crores itself where INR200 crores would be upfront and INR200 based on some milestone
The profitability for the year as a whole was extremely lower and Q1 was also a loss.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we closed around INR562 crores of business, which is a very close number of what we have said
we have been able to bring down our cost of funds by INR0.60

red_flags.label: Corporate NPA recognised late
red_flags.quote: we have recognized the entire INR15.51 crores as an NPA in March

red_flags.label: Fraud loan provisions
red_flags.quote: We have also provided for 43,15,000 fraud loan accounts, which are almost 8 instances

red_flags.label: Profit hit by one-time write-offs in Q4
red_flags.quote: even if you see in Q4, multiple hits we have taken.

red_flags.label: Cost-to-income ~85%
red_flags.quote: right now, it is 85% where we are standing as of now

evasions.quote: Now I will not say like that, by the end of this financial year, you will be having this and that.
No, I think we'll have to get some numbers right.
Not confirmed though, but yes, they wanted to do some due diligence
